description: Deprem Farkındalık ve Güvenli Yaşam Eğitimi Alan Kişi Sayısı is a dataset listed in Istanbul Metropolitan Municipality open data portal, a city open data portal (CKAN), published or maintained by Department of Human Resources and Education. Veri seti kurum tipine göre deprem farkındalık ve güvenli yaşam eğitimi alan kişi sayısını ve bu eğitimin verildiği süre bilgisini içermektedir. Coverage: Department of Human Resources and Education. The publisher named on the listing is Department of Human Resources and Education. Its keywords include Deprem, Deprem Farkındalık Eğitimi, Eğitim, Farkındalık, Güvenli Yaşam, Güvenli Yaşam Eğitimi. The listing shows 1 download or service links in XLSX. The listing shows 2026-03-31 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Istanbul Metropolitan Municipality Open Data License. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-ibb-gov-tr.
